differences.original: Client agrees to pay Service Provider a monthly retainer of $45,000 USD, payable within 30 days of invoice date.
differences.revised: Client agrees to pay Service Provider a monthly retainer of $50,000 USD, payable within 15 days of invoice date. Late payments shall incur interest at 1.5% per month.

differences.original: Service Provider's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by Client in the 12 months preceding the claim.
differences.revised: Service Provider's liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited for matters involving gross negligence, fraud, or breach of confidentiality obligations.

differences.original: Either party may terminate this Agreement with 90 days written notice.
differences.revised: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time with 30 days written notice. Service Provider may only terminate for material breach with 60 days cure period.

differences.original: This Agreement shall continue on a month-to-month basis after the initial term unless terminated by either party.
differences.revised: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless either party provides 90 days written notice. Upon renewal, fees shall increase by 5% or CPI, whichever is greater.

differences.original: Service Provider agrees not to compete with Client for 12 months following termination within the same industry vertical.
differences.revised: Service Provider shall not compete with Client for 18 months following termination within a 50-mile radius and shall not solicit Client's employees.

differences.original: Client shall own all deliverables created specifically for Client. Service Provider retains ownership of pre-existing IP and general methodologies.
differences.revised: All work product and intellectual property created by Service Provider shall be deemed works made for hire and exclusive property of Client, including all copyrights, patents, and trade secrets.

differences.original: Disputes shall be resolved in the state and federal courts located in Delaware.
differences.revised: Disputes shall be resolved exclusively through binding arbitration in New York, New York under AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules.
Service Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance of at least $2,000,000 per occurrence and provide certificates of insurance to Client annually.

differences.original: Neither party shall be liable for delays caused by circumstances beyond their reasonable control, including acts of God, war, terrorism, or government action.
Confidentiality obligations shall survive termination for three years.
differences.revised: Confidentiality obligations shall survive termination for five years.
